svg.title: Summer · an active Dunmari monsoon spell
svg.desc: Nevos moisture reaches Dunmar and some southern Sentinel approaches, with strong terrain control farther inland. An active spell, not an onset calendar. The separate Green Sea summer circulation is shown for geographical context. Full original basemap extent; north up. Purple arrows show air movement. Dark dashed double-headed-chevron arrows show system movement. Colors describe illustrative conditions and pressure influence, not measured values. Unshaded areas have no condition assigned on this plate. The Eastern Isles storm zone is magical. Ocean currents are not shown.

text.tspan: Summer · an active Dunmari monsoon spell
Nevos moisture reaches Dunmar and some southern Sentinel approaches, with strong terrain control farther inland.
The two monsoons have different moisture sources.
No continuous Nevos-to-Sembara trough is assigned.
Unshaded country is not necessarily dry.
Nevos air supplies Dunmar; Emerald Bay is a shifting fringe.
Mountains and distance reduce rain toward the interior.
Cloud and rain sometimes reach exposed foothills and valleys.
The shaded fringe does not define a pass or a fixed boundary.
Aurbez and the high interior do not acquire a full wet summer.
Southern high-country snow remains mainly a winter supply.
An active spell, not an onset calendar. The separate Green Sea summer circulation is shown for geographical context.
SCHEMATIC REVIEW MAPS · Pressure influence, rain areas and tracks have no fixed boundaries or assigned strength.
The five plates are examples, not a synchronized seasonal sequence. Unmodeled regions remain visible.
